subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is: "**could**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "**Could**" is the past tense of "**can**" and is used to express possibility or ability in the past.
 
• In this context, "could" is the most appropriate option as it suggests the possibility of somethin
